reviews.rationale: This installs the reviewed change-risk gate and its documentation; it enforces current review evidence, not semantic application traffic bounds.

controls.request_bound: 0 application or provider requests are made by this review gate; git reads are bounded to 3000 changed files.
controls.fanout_bound: 1 serial gate process per CI run; no application code or review-supplied command is executed.
controls.termination: The CI job stops after five minutes; each git command has a thirty-second timeout and no retry loop.
controls.failure_behavior: Missing revisions, stale digests, missing tests or unsafe workflow settings fail closed rather than claiming safety.

reviews.rationale: This adds repository instructions and workflow review coverage; it changes no application behavior and requires explicit current evidence for future control-plane changes.

controls.request_bound: 0 production provider requests are made by these instructions or their review gate; application test jobs lack production credentials.
controls.fanout_bound: 1 bounded existing review or regression job runs per event; changes to workflow jobs require explicit cost review.
controls.termination: The review job has a five-minute bound and the incident regression job a fifteen-minute bound; source instruction edits execute no code.
controls.failure_behavior: Missing or stale review evidence fails; removing the root policy or changing any workflow requires current acknowledgement and test references.
